entries.title: Laptop replacement policy
entries.content: Employees may request a laptop replacement after 36 months or when hardware fails. Submit a ticket via the IT portal with your asset tag. Standard delivery is 5–7 business days.

entries.title: Password reset procedure
entries.content: Use the self-service portal at https://sso.acme.example/reset. If MFA is unavailable, contact the helpdesk with your employee ID for a one-time unlock link.

entries.title: VPN troubleshooting
entries.content: Verify the VPN client is on the latest version. Clear cached credentials, reboot, and retry. If errors persist, collect client logs and attach them to an IT ticket.
